description: Create the Meta Business Agent for this channel on the given messaging channel. Creates the underlying entities and schedules asynchronous data-preparation jobs, so the agent is not immediately ready to answer. Returns {agent_id}. Onboarding does not switch the agent on: rollout stays disabled until mba_update_agent_settings enables it.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

name: mba_onboard_agent
title: Onboard the agent
